entries.name: Mara Voss
entries.title: Captain of the Ember Wardens
entries.background: Raised in the keep's kitchens, Mara earned her captaincy by holding the Courtyard alone for two nights. She trusts drills over speeches.

entries.name: Tev Quill
entries.title: Scout of the Pass
entries.background: A quiet orphan of the Marches who reads smoke like other people read books.

entries.name: Hest the Quartermaster
entries.title: Keeper of the Stores
entries.background: Counts every arrow twice and every soldier three times.

entries.name: Skarn Ironjaw
entries.title: Brawler of the Horde
entries.background: Cracked his jaw on a Warden shield and never stopped grinning about it.

entries.name: Nok Flamebow
entries.title: Horde Archer
entries.background: Fires pitch-tipped arrows from the ridgeline and runs when anyone gets close.

entries.name: Gruk Smokecaller
entries.title: Warband Shaman
entries.background: Claims the ash talks to him. It mostly says 'attack'.

entries.name: Bolg Redhand
entries.title: Berserker
entries.background: Has never retreated, mostly because he forgets there is a direction for it.
